description: For every m at least two in the F2 complete-chain family, the final regular corner has a unique normalized face polynomial q_m and a unique degree-2m Belyi boundary map with passport (m,m), (2m-1,1), (3,1^(2m-3)) and monodromy group A_{2m}.
